name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=pathfind, descriptor=record_destination_xy). Accurately describes the function: in mode 2, snapshot the neighbor (x,y) and mark best_path_length=1 when the committed tile is flagged as destination. No Ghidra address residue; the 'xy' suffix is a descriptor (stores x then y), not an address.
purpose: Mode-2 destination snapshot: when an in-flight pathfind step commits on a tile flagged as destination (flags byte [-1] bit 0x40 set), record the neighbor (x,y) into the path output buffer and set best_path_length = 1 (destination reached in one step).
logic_summary: Reads the flags byte at btm_attr_ptr[-1] (binary: MOV AL,[EBX-1]; TEST AL,0x40; JZ). If bit 0x40 is clear it returns immediately. If set, it loads the path output buffer pointer (data_fd2_battle_pathfind_path_output_buffer_ptr @ 0x60073) inside the taken branch, stores x to out_buf[0] (DL) and y to out_buf[1] (DH), and sets data_fd2_battle_pathfind_best_path_length (@ 0x60078) = 1. void return. Reached only from the mode-2 commit branch of fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak, which skips the passability gate so a 0x40 tile reaches here instead of being rejected.
signature: void fd2_pathfind_record_destination_xy(uint8 x, uint8 y, uint8 *btm_attr_ptr)

params.name: x
params.semantics: Neighbor tile X coordinate (binary DL). Stored to out_buf[0]. Caller fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak already holds it; passed explicitly in the Layer-2 emit.
params.reason: Accurate single-letter coordinate name matching sibling pathfind helpers; no address residue.

params.name: y
params.semantics: Neighbor tile Y coordinate (binary DH). Stored to out_buf[1]. Passed explicitly in the Layer-2 emit.
params.reason: Accurate single-letter coordinate name matching sibling pathfind helpers; no address residue.

params.name: btm_attr_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to the neighbor tile's marker byte in the battle tile map (binary EBX). Only the flags byte at [btm_attr_ptr-1] is tested (bit 0x40 = destination flag).
params.reason: Matches the consistent naming used by the sibling neighbor-step functions in the same file (btm_attr_ptr = EBX marker pointer); accurately reflects use; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value (binary RET with no result). Side effects only: writes out_buf[0]/[1] and best_path_length on a destination commit.

notes: Disassembly (10 instr) confirms the src is a faithful Layer-2 transcription: MOV AL,[EBX-1]; TEST AL,0x40; JZ; MOV EDI,[0x60073]; MOV [EDI],DL; MOV [EDI+1],DH; MOV [0x60078],1; RET. Single caller fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak @ 0x4E330 (call site 0x4E390, mode-2 commit branch) -- matches plate and src. Name keep, params keep, comment keep. Ghidra plate describes the binary's register-passing convention (DL/DH/EBX, no params) while src describes the explicit-param Layer-2 emit; the two are semantically consistent (not contradictory/outdated), so plate left untouched per the 'consistent => do not touch plate' rule. No Edit made to src/util/pathfnd.c (comment already precise and current), so no clobber risk. reads_globals/writes_globals: the output-buffer GLOBAL POINTER is read; the buffer it points to is written through (out_buf[0]/[1]) -- that pointed-to memory is not itself one of the listed globals; best_path_length global is written directly.
